page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.small is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by a single shared vCPU from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. It runs on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external network-attached storage for operating system and data volumes. Network capabilities are limited, with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The CPU resource allocation is shared, meaning performance can vary based on host node utilization.

Due to its shared CPU architecture and lack of local storage, this instance is designed for cost-sensitive, low-intensity workloads. It is suitable for lightweight applications, development and testing environments, basic web serving with low traffic, and small utility scripts that do not require sustained high CPU performance or high network throughput.
